verifiedClaims.claim: Robot base prices and required inclusions
verifiedClaims.section: Starting at offers; introduction and product selection
verifiedClaims.result: Flex USD24950 and OT-2 USD15950 verified. Mandatory Flex On-Site Installation retained without invented amount. OT-2 base includes one GEN2 single-channel pipette; no automatic duplicate addition.

verifiedClaims.claim: Flex module versus OT-2 module variants
verifiedClaims.result: OT-2 Module Only and Flex caddy/calibration variants are explicit. Category starting amounts correctly do not promise Flex accessories included. Temperature includes a chosen aluminum block; Heater-Shaker includes one selected plate adapter.
Pre-Q3-2025 robots require an upgrade; upgrade cost excluded. Required kit and configuration selection preserved; no complete retrofit total inferred.
Checked orderable product routes expose Add to Cart. No observation says in-stock. Category-only offers remain not-verified. No checkout, reservation, stock count or shipping date verified.

Manufacturer documentation explicitly states discontinued and possible remaining inventory; Sales confirmation needed. Not compatible with Flex. Record keeps residual-stock uncertainty and distinction from passive Flex Magnetic Block.

verifiedClaims.section: Title, manufacturer/supplier description, price and surcharge note
verifiedClaims.result: USD1954.08 display verified for NC1916994 / supplier233648. Description says twelve silicone HV chips; price unit says Pack of 1. Existing record correctly treats this as one purchase package described as12, asks pack verification, labels reseller and excludes dispenser. Contract/account pricing and surcharge caveats retained; no capability claims imported.

limitations: Marker and public-source review cannot prove detection of arbitrary confidential prose or unnamed private figures.

gaps: Dynamic configured checkout totals, inventory, tax, freight, installation amounts, regional applicability and service terms remain unverified as recorded.
Seven null-price manufacturer enquiry routes and their redirect histories were not individually re-opened in this review; no numeric or availability assertion is inferred from them.
This verifies dated public observations, not universal price minima, procurement suitability or future availability.
Review is bound to recorded hashes. UI behavior, future edits and deployment state are outside this evidence review.
Used equipment condition, calibration, software transfer, warranties, current stock and shipping are seller statements or unknown; none independently established.
